rationale: The description specifies a corporate circuit database with controlled access, circuit/customer-data storage, redundancy management, and relational integrity.
evidence_spans: NSDB serves as the corporate circuit database. It provides access to corporate data by authorized systems or administrators.

NSDB is capable of storing Special Services message carrier and non-designed circuit data along with circuit customer data. NSDB is also responsible for redundancy management and the relational integrity of the data
